thread:
sasha: Quick heads-up — I'd like to standardize the 'APAC' label in our public docs to the more explicit 'Asia‑Pacific' (affects prose, SDK examples, and the region matrix). I opened a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/628

sasha: Important notes: keep region codes (e.g., `ap-southeast-1`, `ap-northeast-1`) and endpoint hostnames unchanged. This is only a display/name change and clarifies residency notes for customers. Need i18n + legal to scan residency phrasing where we currently say "APAC residency".

marco: ack. For SDK snippets — do we change inline comments only or param names too?

sasha: inline comments / human-facing strings only. Example change in the Node snippet:

```js
// before
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'APAC' })
// after (docs only)
// region: "Asia-Pacific" is a human label. Keep code values as `ap-southeast-1` in examples:
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'ap-southeast-1' })
```

marco: perfect. I'll sweep SDK snippets in `docs/sdk/` and `docs/quickstarts/`. Will send a tiny PR if I find mismatches.

elaine: tagging legal: @i18n-team and @legal — can you confirm if changing public copy from "APAC residency" to "Asia‑Pacific data residency" needs any compliance caveats?

i18n-team: quick note — for translations we prefer the expanded string; but please keep the shorthand (APAC) in parentheses where space is tight (mobile tables). Otherwise translators will be happier.

ryan: small nit: our region matrix CSV uses a `region_label` column. Make sure the CI check that validates CSV shape doesn't choke if we increase label length. I ran a quick check: `awk -F, '{print length($2)}' docs/data/region-matrix.csv | sort -nr | head -n1` returned 24, which is fine but worth watching.

sasha: thanks. I'll update the PR description with that note and add a CI regression step to run `csvkit` length assertions.

marco: found 3 occurrences in `docs/reference/endpoints.md` where we currently say "APAC endpoints" — submitting a docs-only PR 629 with those fixes.

docs-bot: PR 629 built preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/629 — staging preview ready :white_check_mark:

elaine: legal reviewed the proposed phrasing. Suggestion: use "Asia‑Pacific (APAC) — data may be stored in Singapore, Hong Kong, or Tokyo regions depending on routing." Slight tweak to avoid implying all data is stored in a single country.

sasha: good catch. I'll update the phrase in the PR to that exact wording.

marco: FYI, SDK snippet grep I used: `grep -R "APAC" docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'` — will push fixes for the matches that are purely display strings.

ryan: reminder — we should also update any redirect rules or search terms in the docs site so "APAC" queries still map to the new label. I can add a small redirect boost in algolia config if someone points me to the final phrase.

sasha: filed a follow-up ticket for search synonyms: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-1024 — will link PR 628 and PR 629.

marco: quick QA note — watch for the downloadable region CSV consumers (customers ingesting `region-matrix.csv`). We aren't changing codes but we are changing the label column. Add a short header comment in the CSV noting labels are human-facing.

sasha: done in the PR: added `# labels are human-facing; do not rely on them for programmatic routing` at the top of the CSV.

i18n-team: will queue translator tasks once PR lands. Please include a `i18n: true` frontmatter flag on pages with changed strings so extraction picks them up.

sasha: added `i18n: true` to the three pages in the PR.

marco: merged PR 629, small copy tweaks only.

docs-bot: PR 629 merged into main by marco at 2141600120. Preview archive: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/629/merged

elaine: legal accepts final phrasing as updated in PR 628.

sasha: merged PR 628 at 2141600360. Thanks everyone.

ryan: I've pushed the Algolia synonym for "APAC" -> "Asia-Pacific". Search traffic will be covered.

marco: verified rendered pages; visual diff looks clean. Closing loop: I'll run a quick smoke on mobile to ensure table truncation is ok.

sasha: awesome, thanks team :rocket: 

ryan: leaving a note in the release checklist for next deploy so customer success can be prepared for any inbound questions about the label change.

sasha: closing thread after the release checklist item is marked done. If anything else pops up, re-open or @ me.
